title: Southern Gospel
style: Medium tempo Southern Gospel , fast violin, mandolin, steel guitar, harmonica
lyrics:
Verse 1
Once upon a hill side, Jesus went away, on a cloud of glory that day. The way that He left, He's coming back again, to take The Church back with Him to stay.

Chorus
He's coming back, by popular demand. The Saints are crying out through out the land. Through the storm clouds and the sun, even so Lord Jesus come, He's coming back by popular demand.

Verse 2
This world is use to taking and getting by demand, but there is one thing they should understand. This world will pass away, and the price they'll have to pay, so get ready now, He may come back today.

Repeat Chorus
Repeat Chorus

Tag
He's coming back by popular demand
